description: Convert a Gregorian (ISO, Western) calendar date to the Jalali, Solar Hijri, Persian or Shamsi calendar used in Iran. Use it to display a date to Iranian users, to schedule work in the Iranian calendar, or to convert a Gregorian deadline into a Jalali date. Returns the Jalali year, month, day and month name. ($0.005 per call, USDC on Base)
name: fa_gregorianToJalali
